# x402cloud.ai — Complete Reference

Open-source implementation of the x402 protocol standard. Libraries, facilitator, and tools for HTTP-native payments with USDC.

## Overview

x402cloud.ai implements the x402 protocol standard (x402.org):

- **Protocol implementation** — 5 npm packages: protocol types, EVM payment schemes, server middleware, client SDK, and facilitator logic
- **Hosted facilitator** — On-chain payment verification and USDC settlement at facilitator.x402cloud.ai
- **Services** — metered APIs that agents pay for per call. Live today: `infer.x402cloud.ai` (AI inference, Base Sepolia testnet)

No API keys. No signup. Payment is authentication.

---

## How x402 Works

The x402 protocol adds payment negotiation to standard HTTP using the `402 Payment Required` status code.

### Payment Flow

1. **Request** — Agent sends a normal HTTP request to a paid endpoint
2. **402 Response** — Server returns HTTP 402. The JSON body is the `PaymentRequired` object; the same object base64-encoded is in the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` response header
3. **Sign & Retry** — Client signs a Permit2 USDC authorization (no on-chain tx yet) and retries the request with the base64 payload in the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` request header (legacy name `X-PAYMENT` is still accepted)
4. **Verify** — Server-side middleware sends the payment payload to the facilitator for verification
5. **Process** — If valid, the server processes the request normally
6. **Settle** — After a successful response, the middleware calls the facilitator to settle the payment on-chain via Permit2 transfer and sets the `X-Payment-Settled` response header to the settled amount

### Key Properties

- **Metered (upto) payments**: Client authorizes a max amount, pays only the amount the service's `meter()` reports (never more than authorized)
- **No pre-funding**: Permit2 authorizations are signed off-chain, funds only move on settlement
- **Atomic**: Payment settles only after successful service delivery
- **Stateless**: No sessions, no accounts, no databases — just HTTP headers

### Payment Headers

**PAYMENT-REQUIRED** (402 response header, base64 of the JSON body). Live example from `POST https://infer.x402cloud.ai/fast`:
```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header is required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://infer.x402cloud.ai/fast",
    "description": "Quick and capable"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "upto",
      "network": "eip155:84532",
      "asset": "0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e",
      "amount": "2202",
      "maxAmount": "2202",
      "payTo": "0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 300,
      "extra": { "facilitator": "0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88" }
    }
  ]
}
```

`amount` (the spec's field name) and `maxAmount` (this implementation's original name) always carry the same value, so stock x402 v2 clients can read an offer without special-casing. Amounts are USDC smallest units (6 decimals): `"2202"` = $0.002202.

**PAYMENT-SIGNATURE** (retry request header):
Base64-encoded JSON payload containing the signed Permit2 authorization.

**X-Payment-Settled** (success response header):
The amount actually settled, in USDC smallest units.

---

## Live Services

### infer.x402cloud.ai — Metered AI Inference

OpenAI-compatible AI inference with x402 micropayments. Runs on Cloudflare Workers AI.

- **Base URL**: `https://infer.x402cloud.ai`
- **Format**: OpenAI chat completions API (non-streaming — see Limits)
- **Payment**: x402 `upto` scheme (metered), USDC
- **Recipient**: `0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88`
- **Network**: Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`) — testnet only; Base mainnet is not served
- **Service docs**: https://infer.x402cloud.ai/llms.txt
- **Models list**: https://infer.x402cloud.ai/models

#### Free Endpoints (No Payment Required)

| Endpoint | Method | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `/` | GET | Service info — name, description, docs URL, models list, recipient address |
| `/health` | GET | Health check — returns `{"status":"ok"}` |
| `/models` | GET | OpenAI-compatible model listing with IDs, descriptions, and CF model mappings |
| `/llms.txt` | GET | LLM-readable service documentation |

##### GET / Response

```json
{
  "name": "infer.x402cloud.ai",
  "description": "AI inference using the x402 protocol standard. No signup. No API keys.",
  "docs": "https://infer.x402cloud.ai/llms.txt",
  "models_url": "https://infer.x402cloud.ai/models",
  "payment": "x402 upto (USDC on Base)",
  "recipient": "0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88",
  "models": {
    "nano": { "maxPrice": "$0.000277", "description": "Fastest, simple tasks", "endpoint": "/nano" },
    "fast": { "maxPrice": "$0.002202", "description": "Quick and capable", "endpoint": "/fast" },
    "...": "..."
  }
}
```

##### GET /models Response

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "nano",
      "object": "model",
      "created": 1700000000,
      "owned_by": "x402cloud",
      "description": "Fastest, simple tasks",
      "cf_model": "@cf/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro",
      "maxPrice": "$0.000277"
    },
    "..."
  ]
}
```

#### Paid Endpoints (x402 Payment Required)

All paid endpoints require an x402 payment header. Without it, the server returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

Prices below are the `maxPrice` **ceiling** the 402 asks the client to authorize — not the charge. Settlement meters down (see Pricing and Metering). Ceilings assume a worst case of 500 input + 2,000 output tokens for text, 8,192 input tokens for embeddings, and one 1024x1024 image at 4 steps. Live values: `GET https://infer.x402cloud.ai/models`.

##### Text Models

| Endpoint | CF Model | maxPrice (ceiling) | Description |
|----------|----------|--------------------|-------------|
| `POST /nano` | `@cf/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro` | $0.000277 | Fastest, simple tasks |
| `POST /fast` | `@cf/meta/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct` | $0.002202 | Quick and capable |
| `POST /smart` | `@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct-fast` | $0.000946 | Reliable workhorse |
| `POST /think` | `@cf/deepseek-ai/deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-32b` | $0.012013 | Deep reasoning |
| `POST /code` | `@cf/qwen/qwen2.5-coder-32b-instruct` | $0.002794 | Code specialist |
| `POST /big` | `@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast` | $0.005582 | Highest quality |

**Request format** (text models):

```json
POST /fast
Content-Type: application/json
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64-encoded-payment-payload>

{
  "messages": [
    { "role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant." },
    { "role": "user", "content": "What is the x402 protocol?" }
  ],
  "max_tokens": 512,
  "temperature": 0.7
}
```

**Parameters**:
- `messages` (required): Array of `{ role: "system"|"user"|"assistant", content: string }`
- `max_tokens` (optional, default: 512): Maximum tokens to generate
- `temperature` (optional, default: 0.7): Sampling temperature (0.0-2.0)

**Response format** (OpenAI-compatible):

```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-abc123def456789012345678",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1700000000,
  "model": "fast",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "The x402 protocol adds payment negotiation to HTTP..."
      },
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 25,
    "completion_tokens": 150,
    "total_tokens": 175
  }
}
```

##### Embedding Model

| Endpoint | CF Model | maxPrice (ceiling) | Description |
|----------|----------|--------------------|-------------|
| `POST /embed` | `@cf/baai/bge-m3` | $0.000115 | Text embeddings |

**Request format**:

```json
POST /embed
Content-Type: application/json
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64-encoded-payment-payload>

{
  "input": "The x402 protocol enables micropayments for APIs"
}
```

**Parameters**:
- `input` (required): String or array of strings to embed. Also accepts `messages` format for compatibility.

**Response format** (OpenAI-compatible):

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "embedding",
      "index": 0,
      "embedding": [0.0123, -0.0456, 0.0789, "..."]
    }
  ],
  "model": "embed",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 0,
    "total_tokens": 0
  }
}
```

##### Image Model

| Endpoint | CF Model | Price | Description |
|----------|----------|-------|-------------|
| `POST /image` | `@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell` | $0.002280 flat | Image generation |

`image` is the one route where the ceiling and the charge are always identical: the meter uses a constant 172.8 neurons per generation, and the ceiling is derived from that same constant. It is a flat per-image price, not a metered one. `num_steps` does not change it.

**Request format**:

```json
POST /image
Content-Type: application/json
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64-encoded-payment-payload>

{
  "prompt": "A futuristic city skyline at sunset"
}
```

**Parameters**:
- `prompt` (required): Text description of the image to generate. Also accepts `messages` format for compatibility.
- `num_steps` (optional, default: 4): Number of diffusion steps (higher = better quality, slower)

**Response**: Raw PNG image bytes with `Content-Type: image/png` header.

##### OpenAI-Compatible Routes

| Route | Kind | maxPrice quoted | Default model |
|-------|------|-----------------|---------------|
| `POST /v1/chat/completions` | text | $0.012013 | `nano` |
| `POST /v1/embeddings` | embed | $0.000115 | `embed` |
| `POST /v1/images/generations` | image | $0.002280 | `image` |
| `GET /v1/models` | — | free | — |

The model is not known until the request body is parsed, so each OpenAI route quotes the **highest ceiling among the models it can route to**. `POST /v1/chat/completions` with `{"model":"fast"}` asks for $0.012013 of authorization; `POST /fast` asks for $0.002202. Settlement meters both down to the same real cost, so nobody is overcharged — but an agent sizing a wallet allowance should use the short-name routes, or budget for the higher ceiling.

Model names are resolved through an alias map (`gpt-4o` → `big`, `gpt-4o-mini` → `fast`, `o1` → `think`, `text-embedding-3-small` → `embed`, `dall-e-3` → `image`, plus the short names). **An unrecognised name does not 404** — it silently falls back to the route's default model and is billed at that model's rate.

#### Limits

- **No streaming.** `stream: true` is ignored and the response is always a single JSON body. An OpenAI SDK that expects `text/event-stream` will throw.
- **`POST /v1/images/generations` returns raw PNG bytes** (`Content-Type: image/png`), not OpenAI's `{"created":…,"data":[{"b64_json":…}]}` envelope.
- **Unknown model names fall back silently** rather than erroring.
- **Testnet only.** Base Sepolia; amounts move test USDC.

#### Pricing and Metering

Retail = wholesale × 1.20. Wholesale = Cloudflare Workers AI neurons × $0.000011 per neuron. The 1.20× is `DEFAULT_MARGIN_BPS = 2000` in `@x402cloud/middleware`. There is **no base fee** and no subscription minimum. The smallest amount that can move on-chain is 1 micro-USDC ($0.000001).

| Kind | Metered on |
|------|-----------|
| text (`nano`, `fast`, `smart`, `think`, `code`, `big`) | `usage.prompt_tokens` + `usage.completion_tokens` from the model response; falls back to a `ceil(chars / 4)` estimate when the runtime returns no `usage` |
| `embed` | `ceil(input.length / 4)` — characters of the request, not model-reported tokens |
| `image` | a constant 172.8 neurons per generation — flat, always equal to the ceiling |

Settlement is always `min(metered retail cost, authorized amount)`.

#### Error Responses

| HTTP Status | Description |
|-------------|-------------|
| 402 | Payment required — the JSON body is the `PaymentRequired` object, also base64-encoded in the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` response header |
| 429 | Rate limited on the free discovery routes — returns `{"error": "rate_limited"}` |
| 500 | Server error — returns `{"error": "<message>"}` |

---

### facilitator.x402cloud.ai — Payment Facilitator

Hosted payment verification and USDC settlement service. Used by x402 middleware to verify payments and settle on-chain without servers needing private keys.

- **Base URL**: `https://facilitator.x402cloud.ai`
- **Network**: Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`) — the only network this deployment serves
- **Facilitator address**: `0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88`
- **Service docs**: https://facilitator.x402cloud.ai/llms.txt

#### Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Auth | Description |
|----------|--------|------|-------------|
| `/` | GET | No | Service info and endpoint listing |
| `/health` | GET | No | Health check — returns `{"status":"ok"}` |
| `/supported` | GET | No | Supported schemes, networks, and facilitator address |
| `/verify` | POST | Bearer token | Verify an `upto` payment payload against requirements |
| `/settle` | POST | Bearer token | Settle a verified `upto` payment on-chain via Permit2 |
| `/verify-exact` | POST | Bearer token | Verify an `exact` payment payload |
| `/settle-exact` | POST | Bearer token | Settle a verified `exact` payment on-chain |

##### GET / Response

Returns service info including name, description, supported networks, and available endpoints.

##### GET /supported Response

Live response:
```json
{
  "schemes": ["exact", "upto"],
  "networks": ["eip155:84532"],
  "facilitator": "0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88"
}
```

##### POST /verify

Verifies that an `upto` payment payload is valid and meets the specified requirements.

**Request**:
```json
{
  "payload": { "...": "decoded UptoPayload, not a base64 string" },
  "requirements": {
    "scheme": "upto",
    "network": "eip155:84532",
    "asset": "0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e",
    "amount": "2202",
    "maxAmount": "2202",
    "payTo": "0x207C6D8f63Bf01F70dc6D372693E8D5943848E88",
    "maxTimeoutSeconds": 300
  }
}
```

**Response (success)**:
```json
{
  "isValid": true,
  "payer": "0x..."
}
```

**Response (failure)**:
```json
{
  "isValid": false,
  "invalidReason": "..."
}
```

##### POST /settle

Settles a verified `upto` payment on-chain by executing the Permit2 transfer for the metered amount.

**Request**:
```json
{
  "payload": { "...": "decoded UptoPayload" },
  "requirements": { "...": "same requirements object passed to /verify" },
  "settlementAmount": "1187"
}
```

`settlementAmount` is the metered cost in USDC smallest units and must be ≤ the authorized amount — the proxy contract enforces this on-chain.

**Response (settled)**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "transaction": "0xabc123...",
  "network": "eip155:84532",
  "settledAmount": "1187"
}
```

**Response (failed)**:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "errorReason": "..."
}
```

Settlement is idempotent per `(scheme, nonce)`. If a broadcast is in flight or awaiting a receipt, the endpoint returns HTTP 202 with `"pending": true` and does **not** re-broadcast.

---

## npm Packages

All packages are published under the `@x402cloud` npm scope.

### @x402cloud/protocol

Core types and header encoding for the x402 protocol. Zero dependencies.

```bash
npm install @x402cloud/protocol
```

**Exports**:
- **Types**: `Network`, `Scheme`, `PaymentRequirements`, `PaymentRequired`, `PaymentPayload`, `VerifyResponse`, `SettleResponse`, `MeterFunction`, `RouteConfig`, `RoutesConfig`
- **Header functions**: `encodePaymentHeader(payload)`, `decodePaymentHeader(header)`, `encodeRequirementsHeader(requirements)`, `decodeRequirementsHeader(header)`, `extractPaymentHeader(request)`
- **USDC utilities**: `parseUsdcAmount(humanReadable)` — converts "$0.002202" to the decimal string "2202" (USDC smallest units, 6 decimals); `formatUsdcAmount(units)` — converts those units back to a "$0.002202" string
- **Model registry**: `MODEL_REGISTRY`, `modelKeysOfType(type)`, `ModelType`, `ModelEntry`, `ModelKey`

**Usage**:
```typescript
import { encodePaymentHeader, decodeRequirementsHeader, parseUsdcAmount } from "@x402cloud/protocol";

// Parse a price string to USDC amount (6 decimals)
const amount = parseUsdcAmount("$0.002202"); // "2202" (string, USDC smallest units)

// Decode requirements from a 402 response header
const requirements = decodeRequirementsHeader(response.headers.get("PAYMENT-REQUIRED"));

// Encode a payment payload for the retry request
const header = encodePaymentHeader(signedPayload);
```

### @x402cloud/evm

EVM payment scheme implementations using Permit2. Supports "exact" (fixed price) and "upto" (metered) payment schemes.

```bash
npm install @x402cloud/evm
```

**Exports**:
- **Upto scheme**: `createUptoPayload(config)`, `verifyUpto(payload, requirements)`, `settleUpto(payload, requirements, amount)`
- **Exact scheme**: `createExactPayload(config)`, `verifyExact(payload, requirements)`, `settleExact(payload, requirements)`
- **Types**: `UptoPayload`, `ExactPayload`, `Permit2Authorization`, `Permit2Witness`, `ClientSigner`, `VerifySigner`, `FacilitatorSigner`
- **Constants**: `PERMIT2_ADDRESS` (`0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3`), ABI definitions, contract addresses
- **Utilities**: `parseChainId(network)` — extracts chain ID from network string (e.g., "eip155:8453" → 8453)

**Payment Schemes**:
- **Exact**: Fixed price per call. Client signs for the exact amount. Settlement transfers the full amount.
- **Upto**: Metered pricing. Client authorizes a maximum amount. Settlement transfers only the actual usage amount (always <= authorized max).

**Usage**:
```typescript
import { createUptoPayload } from "@x402cloud/evm";
import { createWalletClient, http } from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { baseSepolia } from "viem/chains";

const account = privateKeyToAccount("0xYOUR_PRIVATE_KEY");
const walletClient = createWalletClient({ account, chain: baseSepolia, transport: http() });

// Both createUptoPayload and createExactPayload take (signer, requirements) —
// `requirements` is one entry from the 402 body's `accepts[]` array, used as-is.
const payload = await createUptoPayload(walletClient, requirements);
```

For the `upto` scheme, `requirements.extra.facilitator` must be present — the Permit2 witness binds the settling facilitator address, and `createUptoPayload` throws without it.

### @x402cloud/client

Client SDK that auto-pays HTTP 402 responses. Wraps `fetch()` to transparently handle payment negotiation.

```bash
npm install @x402cloud/client
```

**Exports**:
- `wrapFetchWithPayment(config)` — Returns a wrapped fetch that auto-pays 402 responses. Takes `PaymentClientConfig` object with `signer` field.
- **Types**: `PaymentClientConfig`, `SchemeHandler`

**Usage**:
```typescript
import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from "@x402cloud/client";
import { createWalletClient, http } from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { baseSepolia } from "viem/chains";

// infer.x402cloud.ai settles on Base Sepolia — the wallet needs Base Sepolia
// test USDC and a one-time Permit2 approval on that same chain.
const account = privateKeyToAccount("0xYOUR_PRIVATE_KEY");
const walletClient = createWalletClient({ account, chain: baseSepolia, transport: http() });

const x402Fetch = wrapFetchWithPayment({ signer: walletClient });

// Use like normal fetch — payments are handled automatically
const response = await x402Fetch("https://infer.x402cloud.ai/fast", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello" }],
    max_tokens: 512,
  }),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data.choices[0].message.content);
```

**How it works**:
1. Makes the initial request as normal
2. If server returns 402, reads the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (falling back to the JSON body)
3. Signs a Permit2 authorization for the required amount
4. Retries the request with the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header containing the signed payload
5. Returns the final response transparently

### @x402cloud/middleware

Hono server middleware for x402 payment gating. Add micropayments to any Hono API.

```bash
npm install @x402cloud/middleware
```

**Exports**:
- `uptoPaymentMiddleware(routes)` — Local middleware (verifies payments directly using local facilitator)
- `remoteUptoPaymentMiddleware(routes, facilitatorUrl)` — Remote middleware (delegates verification to a hosted facilitator)
- `buildUptoMiddleware(routes, verify, settle)` — Low-level middleware builder for custom verification
- `buildPaymentRequired(requirements)` — Manually build a 402 response
- **Types**: `UptoRouteConfig`, `UptoRoutesConfig`, `VerifyFn`, `SettleFn`

**Usage with hosted facilitator** (illustration of gating your own API — the `eip155:8453` below is an example route config, not a description of x402cloud's own services, which run on Base Sepolia only):
```typescript
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { remoteUptoPaymentMiddleware } from "@x402cloud/middleware";

const app = new Hono();

app.use("/*", remoteUptoPaymentMiddleware({
  "POST /api/generate": {
    network: "eip155:8453",
    maxPrice: "$0.01",
    payTo: "0xYOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS",
    description: "AI text generation",
  },
  "POST /api/embed": {
    network: "eip155:8453",
    maxPrice: "$0.001",
    payTo: "0xYOUR_WALLET_ADDRESS",
    description: "Text embeddings",
  },
}, "https://facilitator.x402cloud.ai"));

app.post("/api/generate", async (c) => {
  // This code only runs after payment is verified
  return c.json({ result: "..." });
});
```

**Route config format**: Keys are `"METHOD /path"` strings. Each route specifies network, price, recipient, and optional description.

### @x402cloud/facilitator

Facilitator core for verifying and settling x402 payments on-chain. Use this to run your own facilitator.

```bash
npm install @x402cloud/facilitator
```

**Exports**:
- `createFacilitator(config)` — Create a facilitator instance
- **Types**: `FacilitatorConfig`, `Facilitator`

**Usage**:
```typescript
import { createFacilitator } from "@x402cloud/facilitator";
import { base } from "viem/chains";

// Illustration of running your own facilitator. The hosted facilitator at
// facilitator.x402cloud.ai runs on Base Sepolia; the package itself is
// chain-agnostic, so mainnet config is shown here as an example only.
const facilitator = createFacilitator({
  privateKey: "0xFACILITATOR_PRIVATE_KEY",
  rpcUrl: "https://mainnet.base.org",
  network: "eip155:8453",
  chain: base,
});

// Verify a payment
const verifyResult = await facilitator.verify(payload, requirements);
// { valid: true } or { valid: false, invalidReason: "..." }

// Settle on-chain
const settleResult = await facilitator.settle(payload, requirements, settlementAmount);
// { settled: true, txHash: "0x..." }
```

**Important**: The facilitator needs a funded wallet with ETH for gas fees. The facilitator's private key is used to execute Permit2 transfers on-chain.

---

## Contract Addresses

| Contract | Address | Networks |
|----------|---------|----------|
| Permit2 | `0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3` | All EVM chains (canonical) |
| USDC (Base) | `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913` | Base mainnet |
| USDC (Base Sepolia) | `0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e` | Base Sepolia testnet |
| x402 Upto Proxy | `0x4020A4f3b7b90ccA423B9fabCc0CE57C6C240002` | Base mainnet AND Base Sepolia (same address) |
| x402 Exact Proxy | `0x402085c248EeA27D92E8b30b2C58ed07f9E20001` | Base mainnet AND Base Sepolia (same address) |

Both proxies are the canonical Coinbase contracts, deployed by deterministic CREATE2, so the address is identical on Base mainnet (`eip155:8453`) and Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`). Source of truth: `packages/evm/src/constants.ts` (`X402_UPTO_PROXY`, `X402_EXACT_PROXY`), pinned by `packages/evm/test/proxy-addresses.test.ts`.

---

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐     ┌──────────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────────┐
│  Agent / Client  │────>│  Your API + middleware│────>│  Facilitator        │
│  @x402cloud/     │<────│  @x402cloud/         │<────│  @x402cloud/        │
│  client          │     │  middleware           │     │  facilitator        │
└─────────────────┘     └──────────────────────┘     └─────────────────────┘
        │                         │                           │
        │ Signs Permit2           │ Verifies payment          │ Settles on-chain
        │ (off-chain)             │ via facilitator            │ via Permit2
        v                         v                           v
   ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
   │                    Base (EVM) — USDC                         │
   └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Component Roles

- **Client** (`@x402cloud/client`): Wraps fetch, handles 402 responses by signing Permit2 authorizations and retrying with payment headers.
- **Middleware** (`@x402cloud/middleware`): Intercepts incoming requests, checks for payment headers, delegates verification/settlement to the facilitator.
- **Facilitator** (`@x402cloud/facilitator`): Verifies payment signatures off-chain, executes Permit2 transfers on-chain for settlement. Holds the private key needed for on-chain transactions.
- **Protocol** (`@x402cloud/protocol`): Shared types and header encoding/decoding used by all components.
- **EVM** (`@x402cloud/evm`): Low-level Permit2 signing and verification logic for both exact and upto payment schemes.

### Network Configuration

| Network | Chain ID | CAIP-2 | USDC Address | Status |
|---------|----------|--------|--------------|--------|
| Base Sepolia | 84532 | eip155:84532 | 0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e | **The only network x402cloud services run on today** |
| Base mainnet | 8453 | eip155:8453 | 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 | Supported by the packages; not served by our hosted services |

---

## End-to-End Example

Full example: calling infer.x402cloud.ai with automatic payment using the client SDK.

```typescript
import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from "@x402cloud/client";
import { createWalletClient, http } from "viem";
import { privateKeyToAccount } from "viem/accounts";
import { baseSepolia } from "viem/chains";

// 1. Set up wallet — Base Sepolia, the network infer.x402cloud.ai settles on
const account = privateKeyToAccount(process.env.PRIVATE_KEY as `0x${string}`);
const walletClient = createWalletClient({
  account,
  chain: baseSepolia,
  transport: http(),
});

// 2. Wrap fetch with x402 payment handling
const x402Fetch = wrapFetchWithPayment({ signer: walletClient });

// 3. Call the inference API (payment is automatic)
const response = await x402Fetch("https://infer.x402cloud.ai/fast", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    messages: [
      { role: "system", content: "You are a helpful assistant." },
      { role: "user", content: "Explain the x402 protocol in one paragraph." },
    ],
    max_tokens: 256,
    temperature: 0.7,
  }),
});

// 4. Use the response (OpenAI-compatible format)
const data = await response.json();
console.log(data.choices[0].message.content);
console.log(`Tokens used: ${data.usage.total_tokens}`);
```

**Prerequisites**:
- A wallet with Base Sepolia test USDC (https://faucet.circle.com) and Base Sepolia ETH for the one-time approval's gas
- Permit2 approval for USDC spending on Base Sepolia (one-time on-chain transaction)
- Node.js 18+ with `@x402cloud/client` and `viem` installed
